```yaml
name: Publish Skills

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - '.skills/**'
      - 'skill.md'
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      force:
        description: 'Re‑publish all skills'
        required: false
        default: 'false'
        type: boolean

jobs:
  publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install ClawHub CLI
        shell: bash
        run: |
          curl -sL https://github.com/openclaw/clawhub/releases/latest/download/clawhub-linux-amd64.tar.gz | tar xz
          sudo mv clawhub /usr/local/bin/

      - name: Get changed files
        if: github.event_name == 'push'
        uses: Ana06/get-changed-files@v2.3.0
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          format: csv
          filter: '.*'
        id: changed

      - name: Publish skills
        shell: bash
        env:
          CLAWHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CLAWHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          # Authenticate with ClawHub
          clawhub login --token "$CLAWHUB_TOKEN"

          # Determine if we should publish all skills
          PUBLISH_ALL=false
          if [[ "${{ github.event_name }}" == "workflow_dispatch" && "${{ github.event.inputs.force }}" == "true" ]]; then
            PUBLISH_ALL=true
          fi

          SKILLS_TO_PUBLISH=()

          if $PUBLISH_ALL; then
            while IFS= read -r dir; do
              SKILLS_TO_PUBLISH+=("$dir")
            done < <(find .skills -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type d)
          else
            # Parse changed files from the get-changed-files step
            CHANGED_FILES=$(echo "${{ steps.changed.outputs.added_modified }}" | tr ',' '\n')
            for file in $CHANGED_FILES; do
              if [[ "$file" =~ ^\.skills/([^/]+)/ ]]; then
                skill="${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"
                if [[ ! " ${SKILLS_TO_PUBLISH[*]} " =~ " $skill " ]]; then
                  SKILLS_TO_PUBLISH+=("$skill")
                fi
              fi
            done
          fi

          if [ ${#SKILLS_TO_PUBLISH[@]} -eq 0 ]; then
            echo "No skills to publish."
            exit 0
          fi

          for skill in "${SKILLS_TO_PUBLISH[@]}"; do
            echo "Publishing skill: $skill"
            clawhub publish ".skills/$skill" --accept-license-terms
          done
```
